root: ^I'm keen to say you aren't from here, you have a travlers edge to you. That and I've never seen you around town. Hehehehe.
^We don't get many vistitors you see, for obvious reasons of course.
^Ma says I'm not built for the bow anyhow, or the sword for that matter. Hehehehe.
^What's the outside world like? Is it true that there are trees the size of giants? And rivers that expand miles...
^ You let the townsman go on and on about the wonders of the world he has yet to see
